name: [UPDATE 2] Meme Fruits
desc:
Welcome to Meme Fruits!

Like the game for NEW UPDATE!!

Current Level Cap: 2600
New Code: RAZOR

RAZOR UPDATE
- New Moai Island
- New LEGENDARY Low Taper Razor Weapon
- New Side Quest on Moai Island

Basic Controls
[Q] – Quick Dash
[Spacebar] – Jump
[Ctrl] – Sprint
[R] – Flash Step
[Y] – Aura
[E] – Instinct
[T] – Race Ability

Available Powers:
Enjoy a variety of exciting powers, including Bomb, Smoke, Water, Moai, Rock, Dark, Flame, Ice, Potato, Floppa, Light, Dough, Doge, Noob, Popcat, and Curse Fruit!

FAQ
Fruits appear on the map every hour and remain for 20 minutes.
You can purchase fruits from the Meme Gacha!
The Meme Hydra appears every 60 minutes.
